name: Stone Age
tagline: Tap the rock. Knock off a corner. Repeat until round.
intro: You pick up a rock. You have a feeling about this rock. It wants to be round.

completions: perfectly round. You weep a single prehistoric tear.
rolled away before you could name it.
has a small chip. You call it 'character'.
your apprentice says it looks 'mid'. You don't know what that means yet.
so round it makes the moon jealous.

upgrades.name: Sharper Rock
upgrades.firstBuy: You have invented the tool. You use it to reinvent the wheel. Priorities.

upgrades.name: Cave Apprentice
upgrades.description: Chips 1 corner per second. Mostly the right corners.
upgrades.firstBuy: Your apprentice asks what a wheel is for. You do not know yet. Keep chiseling.

upgrades.name: Picky Rock Sourcing
upgrades.description: New rocks start with one more side. Fewer corners per wheel.
upgrades.firstBuy: You now reject rocks for being "too pointy". The other cave people find this exhausting.

upgrades.name: Wheel Shaman
upgrades.description: Chants at rocks. 8 corners/s fall off out of sheer embarrassment.
upgrades.firstBuy: The Shaman declares the wheel sacred. Squares everywhere are nervous.

upgrades.name: Wrist of the Ancients
upgrades.description: +5 corners per tap. Your forearm is now 60% of your body.
upgrades.firstBuy: Your tapping technique is passed down for generations. Mostly as a warning.

upgrades.name: Wheel Committee
upgrades.description: Twelve elders chisel 50 corners/s between debates.
upgrades.firstBuy: The Committee's first motion: rename 'wheel' to 'round rock'. Tabled.
